title: Introduce adaptive preflight checks and hook overlay parameters
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Private installs suffer from noisy preflight failures and brittle init hooks when tenants have heterogeneous network/topology constraints. This PR adds a small adaptive preflight framework plus a lightweight overlay mechanism for hook templates so operators can tune preflight probes and init-wave sequencing per-tenant without duplicating charts. Approach summary: 1) Add charts/private/values.schema.json extensions to validate overlay sections and per-tenant probe profiles; 2) Introduce charts/private/templates/hooks/_overlay.tpl and plumbing to render overlay parameters into existing init hook templates; 3) Implement an adaptive preflight controller stub (preflight probe CR template + explanatory README) that supports exponential backoff and a permissive-fallback mode; 4) Add values.example.yaml with tenantSandboxing and initWaveOrder examples; 5) Add helm-level unit/integration tests and a short upgrade script. Compatibility & safety: All new values are optional and default to current behavior; the overlay template is guarded by a feature flag values.private.init.enableOverlay=false by default. Migration: chart will accept existing values unchanged; operators who want per-tenant tuning can populate values.private.init.overlays.<tenant> entries as documented. Rollout plan: ship to Canary (dedicated) then gradual rollout to >=3 customer clusters before marking GA. Testing & validation: helm lint and unit tests added; integration job exercises three overlay permutations. Follow-ups: wire the adaptive controller into private-installer controller and add a metrics export for preflight probe histograms (tracked ENG-9021).

release_notes: Introduce optional tenant-scoped hook overlay parameters to tune init jobs per-tenant
Add adaptive preflight probe template with backoff and permissive fallback mode
Values schema extended with tenantSandboxing and initWaveOrder examples
No behaviour change by default; feature gated behind values.private.init.enableOverlay=false
migration_instructions: This release is backward-compatible. To enable per-tenant overlays populate values.private.init.overlays with tenant keys. See charts/private/values.example.yaml for examples. If you upgrade from a chart older than 2025-07 ensure your CI does not rely on implicit timing assumptions during init; recommended to run 'helm upgrade --install --dry-run' and then apply the preflight probe CR as described in README-upgrade.md.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge to main and publish chart-rc to Canary registry. 2) Deploy Canary to one dedicated customer cluster and monitor preflight probe metrics for 48h. 3) If stable, enable overlay in 2 additional clusters and run integration tests. 4) Promote to stable in 7 days after zero regressions. Rollback: revert values.private.init.enableOverlay or roll back chart revision via helm rollback.
